data.name: Lose Your Way
data.description: As a standard action, a bloody jake can spend one use of cruel tricks to cause a creature that is within 30 feet and within the bloody jake's favored terrain to become disoriented, taking a -%1 penalty on Survival checks and a -2 penalty on saving throws against fear and illusions. This effect lasts for %1 hours of the bloody jake or for as long as the affected creature remains within the bloody jake's favored terrain, whichever is shorter.|SlayerLVL
